name: mental
description: Build, explain, assess, and maintain evidence-linked mental models for repositories and learning material.

interface.shortDescription: Build and assess verifiable models for code and learning.
interface.longDescription: Agent-native workflows that turn supplied repositories and learning sources into reviewable mental models, adaptive lessons, bounded assessments, and evidence-aware change decisions.
defaultPrompt: Explain this repository through its mental model.
Build a draft mental model from these sources.
Diagnose what I need to learn next.
Quiz me on the current change.
